title: Tick-Borne Encephalitis (TBE) Seropersistence After First Booster and Response to a Second Booster in Children, Adolescents and Young Adults (Follow-Up to Study 700401)
brief_summary: The main purpose of this study is to assess the seropersistence of TBE virus antibodies in children, adolescents and young adults who received the first booster vaccination with either FSME-IMMUN 0.25 mL Junior or FSME-IMMUN 0.5 mL in precursor Study 700401.
